title: PAH Materialization Manifest v1
description: Frozen manifest contract for Slice 8 (Hermes) and Slice 9 (OpenClaw). Renderer-agnostic. The harness-specific layout is encoded in `harness` plus the renderer version; the bytes themselves are base64-encoded so the manifest is JSON-safe across processes.

runId.description: Unique run identifier stamped at apply time.

snapshotId.description: Snapshot id the materialization was derived from.

harness.description: Target harness. Slice 8 only writes 'hermes'; Slice 9 reuses the same contract.

targetRoot.description: Absolute or workspace-relative target root (resolved by the materializer at apply time; never autodetected).

relativePath.description: Forward-slash relative path inside the target root. No leading slash, no '..', no empty segments.

bytes.description: Base64-encoded file bytes. The bytes must decode to a UTF-8 / LF canonical text artefact.

mode.description: POSIX mode bits. Standard for materialised text files is 0644.

generatedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp the manifest was generated.

rendererVersion.description: Renderer version (semver). A renderer bump always forces a re-preview.
